entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I want to return this helmet I bought. Your service is unbelievable. I've been on hold for ten minutes!
I do apologize for the wait time. I can certainly help you with a return. Can I get your order number to start?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I ordered this thing almost two months ago and the color is just hideous, nothing like the website. I want my money back, now.
Okay, I see the order for the Trail Helmet, delivered on December 1st, 2025. That was about 55 days ago.

Are you telling me I can't return it? I'll tell you right now, I haven't even touched it. The box is unopened! If you don't give me a refund, I am going straight to your manager and I will plaster this all over social media!
No, not at all, sir. I just need to confirm the details. Let me quickly review the return policy for you... one moment.
This is ridiculous. It's a simple return for a brand new helmet. There shouldn't be anything to 'review'!
Okay, I've confirmed it. Per our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Well... fine. About time. So what happens now?

I've just emailed a prepaid return label to the address on file. Just package the helmet back up—we take product safety very seriously, even on returns—and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed.
Whatever. Just make sure it goes through.
I will. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
